cards.name: Bomb
cards.text: Opens cave entrances in mountain walls and destroys boulders on land, unlocking a secret reward or revealing enemies in that square.

cards.name: Digging Mitts
cards.text: Digs up green, X-marked plots of soil, unlocking a secret reward.

cards.name: Power Bracelet
cards.text: Moves boulders and grave stones and destroys Armos statues, unlocking a secret reward.

cards.name: Ice Arrow
cards.text: Extinguishes rings of flame, unlocking a secret reward.

cards.name: Goddess's Harp
cards.text: Plays music for swarms of Goddess Butterflies to uncover a Gossip Stone, revealing enemies in that square.

cards.name: Compass
cards.text: Reveals all secrets within a battle square, making their tiles sparkle.

cards.name: Recorder
cards.text: Drains certain small bodies of water and also removes certain bushes and grave stones or reveal hidden stairs on regular patches of land or desert sand, revealing enemies in that square.

cards.name: Water Bomb
cards.text: Destroys boulders in bodies of water, unlocking a secret reward.

cards.name: Hookshot
cards.text: Pulls Warrior to a marked target, removing locks on certain adjacent squares so that they can be opened normally.

cards.name: Candle
cards.text: Burns bushes, unlocking a secret reward.

cards.name: Raft
cards.text: Crosses water from docks, removing locks on certain adjacent squares so that they can be opened normally.

cards.name: Ladder
cards.text: Crosses gaps in rundown docks, unlocking a secret reward.
